rows.item: Sokol space suit of Ravish Malhotra (backup to Rakesh Sharma, Soyuz T-11 Indo-Soviet mission), shown beside the Soyuz T-10 descent module
rows.notes: Wikipedia names the Soyuz T-10 'along with his space suit' and captions a gallery image 'Space Suit used by Ravish Malhotra'; secondary search summaries say the original Malhotra suit is displayed. Museum page not readable; whose suit and exact model (Sokol KV-2) unconfirmed.
